description: kontentkop-agent-output — Stop / SubagentStop hook that scores the agent's own last reply with KontentKop and logs scores, Body Count and the CriticMarkup annotation to the user's state directory. The Go binary under hooks/bin/ embeds the scorer (no subprocess, scores on every reply); if no binary matches the platform, the pure-Node hook runs instead and needs KONTENTKOP_BIN. Log and pass through by default; KONTENTKOP_AGENT_OUTPUT_BLOCK_AT=<BC> turns on blocking at that Body Count.
